title: cron v1 payload
description: Immutable scheduled-occurrence value delivered for a workflow's cron trigger.

schedule_id.description: The durable schedule this occurrence belongs to.

generation.description: Schedule generation at the time this occurrence fired; bumped whenever the schedule is reconciled.

schedule_arn.description: Provider schedule ARN that produced this occurrence.

scheduled_at.description: UTC or offset-qualified time this occurrence was scheduled to fire.

execution_id.description: Provider-assigned identifier for this specific firing attempt.

attempt_number.description: Delivery attempt number for this occurrence.

trigger_name.description: The named trigger in the workflow that this occurrence fires.
